construct: Platelet dense granules contain ADP, serotonin and high concentrations of calcium. After platelet activation, dense-granule ADP is released and amplifies recruitment and aggregation through purinergic platelet receptors, especially P2Y12.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Platelet dense granules/dense bodies contain ADP, serotonin, and calcium; released ADP amplifies platelet recruitment and aggregation through purinergic signaling.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: vWF, fibrinogen, PF4, and fibronectin are biologically plausible platelet-granule contents but are alpha-granule proteins, not the small-molecule dense-body agonist specified.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The electron-microscopic dense-body deficiency plus impaired secondary recruitment uniquely selects ADP.
